description: Use-case catalog for the generic-screen-v2 suite, derived from the benchmark-to-use-case mapping. Thresholds are draft values until calibrated.

use_cases.name: Structured extraction
use_cases.description: Return structured data that follows an explicit schema, without inventing fields.

use_cases.name: Code generation
use_cases.description: Write small functions that satisfy an executable contract.

use_cases.name: Contextual question answering
use_cases.description: Answer only from a supplied context, filtering distractors and abstaining when unsupported.

use_cases.name: Reasoning and analysis
use_cases.description: Solve bounded multi-step calculations and deductions with a verifiable result.

use_cases.name: Classification and routing
use_cases.description: Assign a message to one label of a defined taxonomy, including abstention.

use_cases.name: Summarization
use_cases.description: Preserve the important facts, negations and constraints of a source text.

use_cases.name: Concise communication
use_cases.description: Produce helpful, safe and concise business communication.

use_cases.name: Instruction following
use_cases.description: Follow precise output and clarification instructions.
